rows.text: returns at once when qword `rcx+0x20` is 0; otherwise, with `rdx` = `rcx+0x20`, tail-jumps to `001EB800` directly when byte `+0x26e` is non-zero; else increments dword `+0x28` and, when it is still below dword `+0x30` (signed), adds float `+0x38` to float `+0x34` and tail-jumps to `001EB800`; when it is not below, stores 0 into float `+0x34` if that float is negative, sets dword `+0x30` to -1, zeroes qword `+0x20` and tail-jumps to `001EB800`
